Structural design, with attention to how things actually work.

Hi, I'm Fahdil Dagold, a Structural Design Engineer with a background in civil engineering and a particular interest in the analysis and design of reinforced concrete structures.

My work involves translating architectural concepts into structural systems through modelling, analysis, design and detailing. I use ProtaStructure for structural modelling and analysis, and AutoCAD for technical drawings, with design experience based on BS 8110.

Chapter 02

About

A structural design engineer who models, designs and details reinforced concrete buildings.

My portfolio features a triplex residential building, documenting my involvement in the structural design process, from floor slab design to structural modelling, foundation design and reinforcement detailing. My work covers beams, columns, slabs, pad foundations and staircases, from interpreting architectural drawings through ProtaStructure modelling and design to AutoCAD reinforcement drawings.

I hold a B.Tech in Civil Engineering from Ladoke Akintola University of Technology.

Section 02

Structural system

The frame, its members and its foundations at a glance.

230 x 230Columns, mm
230 x 450Beams, mm (230 x 600 on selected members)
150Slabs, mm thick
200Assumed soil pressure, kN/m²
  • Reinforced concrete frame on pad footings, over five levels: foundation, ground slab, first floor, second floor and roof.
  • One column section is used throughout: 230 x 230 mm.
  • Beams are 230 x 450 mm, with 230 x 600 mm on selected members.
  • Slabs are 150 mm thick and span between the supporting beams.
  • Isolated pad footings are provided under every column.
  • Wall panels are modelled between beams.
  • Design to BS 8110-1997 (concrete) with loading to BS 6399.

    Section 06

    Analytical model, loading and load combinations

    PERFORMED
    CombinationFactors
    G+Q1.4G + 1.6Q
    (G+Q)p11G + 0.4Gp1 + 1.6Qp1
    (G+Q)p21G + 0.4Gp2 + 1.6Qp2
    G+Q+Nx, G+Q-Nx1.2G + 1.2Q +/- 1Nx
    G+Q+Ny, G+Q-Ny1.2G + 1.2Q +/- 1Ny

    Load cases

    • G: dead loads. Q: live loads.
    • Gp1, Gp2: pattern dead loads. Qp1, Qp2: pattern live loads.
    • Nx, Ny: notional loads in X and Y.

    Loading code: BS 6399. Concrete design code: BS 8110-1997.

    ↑ Contents
    Section 08

    First-floor slab design

    PERFORMED

    Design summary

    • Slab thickness: 150 mm, spanning between 230 mm wide beams.
    • Designed to BS 8110-1997 with loading to BS 6399 (1.4G + 1.6Q).
    • 13 slab panels, P1 to P13, each designed and detailed.
    • Reinforcement: Y10 and Y12 bars, top and bottom, at 150 to 250 mm centres.
    • Every bar group is marked with number, size, bar mark, spacing and position (T or B).
    • Overall and panel dimensions are given on the layout.
    ↑ Contents
    Section 09

    Second-floor and ground slab design

    PERFORMED

    Design summary

    • 150 mm slab, panels P1 to P12, designed to BS 8110-1997.
    • Y10 and Y12 reinforcement at 150 to 250 mm centres, top and bottom, detailed on the layout.
    • The layout shows the beams, the staircase opening and dimensions to the grid.
    • Ground floor slab: 150 mm thick on fill, reinforced with A142 wire mesh.
